summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Easton Rangers, a football club based in Freetown, Sierra Leone. It states the club currently competes in the Sierra Leone National First Division, which the note describes as the second highest football league in the country.
one_line: Easton Rangers is a Freetown, Sierra Leone football club currently playing in the Sierra Leone National First Division.
key_facts: Easton Rangers is a Sierra Leonean football club.

The Sierra Leone National First Division is the second highest football league in Sierra Leone.
